search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Find messages by their text across every account of the organisation.
search.disabled_body: Turn on the switch "Full-text search" for the organisation in Settings, Feature switches. New mail is indexed from then on; older mail after a reindex in each account's Settings tab.
search.disabled_ask_admin: Ask an owner or admin of the organisation to turn it on.
search.prompt_body: Type words to find. Use "quotes" for an exact phrase and a minus sign to exclude a word, for example: invoice "payment due" -reminder.
search.no_results_body: Matching is on whole words. Try fewer words, another spelling or a wider date range.
search.total_capped: Showing the best 1000 matches. Refine the search to see others.
search.reindex_hint: Adds this account's older mail to full-text search. New mail is indexed automatically.
search.reindex_confirm_body: EmailBridge reads the bodies of up to 5000 recent messages from the mail server, one at a time, and adds the missing ones to the full-text index. The account stays usable meanwhile.
search.reindex_queued: Reindex started. It runs in the background.
search.meaning_pick_account: Pick an account to search by meaning or ask a question.
search.meaning_reason_switch_off: Semantic search is off for this account. Turn on "Semantic search" in Settings, Feature switches.
search.meaning_reason_fulltext_off: Semantic search needs full-text search on for this account.
search.meaning_reason_ai_off: The AI plugin is off for this account.
search.meaning_reason_not_configured: Semantic search needs an embeddings endpoint in Settings, AI.
search.meaning_coverage: {messages} of {indexed} indexed messages can be searched by meaning.
search.meaning_prompt_body: Describe what you are looking for in your own words, in any language. The closest messages of the selected account come first.
search.meaning_no_results_body: Nothing in this account is close enough. Try other words, a wider date range, or embed older mail from the account's Settings tab.
search.ask_hint: The answer is written from the messages closest to your question and names the messages it uses.
search.ask_nothing_embedded: Nothing in this account can be searched by meaning yet. Use "Embed mail" in the account's Settings tab.
search.ask_disclaimer: Written by your AI provider from the excerpts above. Check the sources before you rely on it.
search.embed_hint: {messages} of {indexed} indexed messages can be searched by meaning. New mail is added automatically.
search.embed_confirm_body: EmailBridge sends the text of up to 5000 recent indexed messages to the embeddings provider in your AI settings, in batches, and stores the vectors. Messages already embedded are skipped.
search.embed_queued: Embedding started. It runs in the background.
search.ask_range: Only messages within the search's message-date range are used.
